verdicts.typography: Excellent hierarchy and mono-label discipline. One minor line-height orphans the final stat label in the hero strip, slightly breaking the vertical rhythm.
verdicts.color: Flawless execution of the single-accent red constraint. Near-black on white provides strong contrast. No off-brand colors or visual noise detected.
verdicts.layout: Strong grid alignment and whitespace rhythm. The analysis grid (d4) shows a minor rendering artifact where card 5 has a grey background fill inconsistent with the white cards above it, breaking the strict monochrome rule.
verdicts.components: High-quality matrix table with clear legend and sticky header behavior. Accordion affordances are clean. Minor nitpick: the matrix column headers could benefit from stricter text-wrapping or reduced font-size to prevent slight overflow/overlap in dense views.
verdicts.responsive: Flawless mobile and dark-mode execution. Mobile layout at 390px shows perfect integrity with no overflow or clipped text, correct stacking of the 2x2 grid, and highly readable typography. The wide matrix table handles horizontal scrolling elegantly with a sticky first column that remains visible during swipe (m3b). Dark-mode palette is consistent across all components with excellent contrast ratios for both text and UI elements.

typography: Increase line-height or padding in the hero stat strip (d1) so the 'EXPORT-READY REGIONS' micro-label does not sit flush against the container bottom border.
layout: Remove the light-grey background from card 5 in the Analysis section (d4) to match the white background of cards 1-4 and maintain strict Swiss-style monochrome consistency.
components: Review matrix header text wrapping (d3) to ensure all 9 column titles fit cleanly without perceived crowding; consider tightening tracking or reducing size by 1px if needed.
